title: gait-summary/1
description: One run of `fy gait <spec>`: joint loads for level treadmill walking on Freyja's mass distribution, computed three ways (B own dynamics, A measured force scaled, H own total force at the measured CoP) from the Camargo et al. 2021 kinematics. Stamped like a run record. Statistics are across subject-strides as {mean, p95, max}, with an `all` and a `without_offset` variant (the spec's offset_subjects removed). Torques are N m about the model's hinge axes, speeds rad/s, powers W, forces % of Freyja's body weight, angles degrees. Written by sim/scripts/gait.py; CONVENTIONS section 6.

spec_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the spec

pitch_mean.description: 'measured' or a number of degrees (anterior positive, relative to the standing pose)

trunk.description: The trunk modes run, in spec order (the spec's `trunk` is a name or a list). rigid: spine and neck at the standing pose relative to the pelvis; counter_rotate: the lumbosacral lateral and axial joints cancel the pelvis roll and yaw. Every result and sensitivity table is keyed by mode.

hybrid_methods.description: methods A and H run with a numeric pitch_mean: a measured force and CoP on a posture they do not belong to

results.description: Per speed (key '1.4') and then per trunk mode: n_strides, joints{joint{method{metric{all,without_offset{mean,p95,max}}}}}, bound (worst case over the feasible double-support splits), residual, agreement, band (per method, `all` and `without_offset`: the envelope band verdict, the sagittal stems pooled over both limbs), feasibility (CoP outside / friction exceeded, by phase bin), hip_extension, kinematics.

sensitivity.description: 95th-percentile peak torque of method B per joint, as sensitivity[kind][value][trunk mode][speed][joint], at each smoothing cutoff (cutoff_hz) and pelvis-pitch offset (pitch_offset_deg), on stride_cap_per_subject strides per subject.
